parserNotes: Global process flags are stripped only before each command terminator; later argv is owned by the command.
Only launch/setup/dev accept theme flags; resume is only a top-level launch modifier.
There is no universal subcommand --help guarantee. Never invoke an unknown help form with real credentials during inventory.
External tar/git arguments in skills/source/archive.ts and local.ts are subprocess implementation details, not Vesicle CLI flags.
The quality benchmark parser currently accepts additional value flags it does not consume. This permissiveness is a known limitation, not a promised new option.
